aggregation: sum numerators and denominators across all four targets; never average star ratios
direct_denominator: realclean and in_search_range=true, all injected signals
gate_loss: (realclean in-range direct+alias before gate - recovered after gate) / recovered before gate; zero denominator is invalid
noise_false_peaks: sum of saved peaks passing SNR>=7 AND SDE>=6 on noise*/none; no additional transit-count filter
failure_policy: do not tune on holdout; v2 independent evaluation requires a new unused holdout
